name: ebooks
description: Search, check, and request ebooks through Bookshelf (a Readarr fork). Supports looking up books, adding idempotent ebook requests to Bookshelf, and tracking acquisition and import status.
instructions: User setup: 1) In Bookshelf, open Settings > General and copy the API key; keep it secret. 2) Set bookshelf_url to http://host.docker.internal:8787 when Bookshelf is on the host reachable from the plugin runner. 3) Set bookshelf_api_key to that key. 4) Optional names default to root_folder_name=Bookshelf Sandbox, quality_profile_name=eBook, and metadata_profile_name=Standard; change them only when your Bookshelf names differ. 5) Leave http_timeout_seconds at 15 unless needed, then run books_status.

bookshelf_url.description: Bookshelf base URL (e.g. http://host.docker.internal:8787). Must be reachable from the plugin runner.

bookshelf_api_key.description: Bookshelf API key from Settings > General or config.xml. Never share or log this value.

root_folder_name.description: Name of the Bookshelf root folder used when adding new authors.

quality_profile_name.description: Name of the Bookshelf quality profile used when adding new authors (e.g. eBook).

metadata_profile_name.description: Name of the Bookshelf metadata profile used when adding new authors.

http_timeout_seconds.description: Per-request Bookshelf HTTP timeout in seconds (greater than 0 and at most 120).
